title: Eagle Ridge RV Park

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Staying a while in Grandview is easy when your site is set up for it, and our long term RV sites give you room to spread out and truly settle in. With 57 RV sites offering full hookups, laundry on-site, a pool for hot Texas afternoons, a community center for gatherings, and a quiet pond to walk by in the evening, the everyday details are handled. Work crews, snowbirds, families, and full-timers all find their place here, and all ages are welcome year-round. You're a short drive from Cleburne, Hillsboro, and Chisholm Trail Parkway access to Fort Worth, with Lake Whitney and Cleburne State Park close by for weekends off.
